description: Source code for cryptographic functions used in the EAD (Encrypted Authentication Data) protocol, including key setup, message encryption/decryption, and IV management.

methods.name: ead_set_key
methods.description: Initializes encryption and decryption contexts with the provided symmetric key, and sets IVs.

methods.name: ead_encrypt_message
methods.description: Encrypts a message, computes its SHA1 hash, and appends padding.

methods.name: ead_decrypt_message
methods.description: Decrypts a message, verifies IV and hash, and returns the plaintext length.
